Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Ishaan - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Shalini - 40 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Nitin - 38 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
4. Ananya - 10 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Ishaan stands on the road. Shalini and Nitin stand near him.]

Shalini: "What lovely weather!"

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Ishaan sits in the back seat.]

Ishaan (happily): "Yes, of course."

[Ishaan sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Ishaan (laughing): "That's easy."

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Ishaan in the back.]

Ishaan: "What a day to remember!"
